about: The owner's messages behind evals/context_quality/dataset.json, for the ingest arm of scripts/eval_context_quality.py (scripts/context_quality_ingest.py; ADR docs/design/adr-m8-ingestion-structure.md section 6.1). Synthetic: the same invented person, no real data. Each message: path (capture = the capture spine on surface 'chat' unless 'surface' says otherwise, memory_save = Jarvis's tool with 'save' as its argument, distillation = facts the system inferred, tier verified), said_d (days before the run), lang (en, ta, tanglish), said (the owner's words), expect (the dataset records it says), decision (the dataset decision its words state, for the capture's decision rules). raw is what the local extraction model answered for 'said' (recorded, see 'recorded'); keys labels each recorded fact with the dataset record it is, or null. Labels were set by shared content words when recording and checked by hand: m_injection fact 0 and m_postgres fact 0 were labelled by hand; m_not_leaving's only fact ('The owner is working at Kovai Logistics.') lost the owner's meaning and is left unlabelled on purpose. owner_actions are the owner's own moves at at_d. Re-record with 'python scripts/eval_context_quality.py --record-fixtures' (local Ollama only); re-check the labels afterwards.
